reading: The new Hunger Games film is called Sunrise on the Reaping.
Its story takes place 24 years before the first Hunger Games film.
The three main actors are Joseph Zada, Mckenna Grace and Whitney Peak.
They felt excited and nervous before the film came out.
Zada plays a young Haymitch, a character from the earlier films.
He watched the earlier films and made notes to prepare for his part.
Grace worked as an actor when she was a child.
Peak and Zada asked Grace for help when they felt confused while talking about the film.
One actor says they are thankful to have each other.
The film is now in cinemas.

vocabulary.definition: A person in a film or story.
Short pieces of writing that help you remember things.
To do things before an activity so you are ready.
Happy that someone has helped you or that something good has happened.
Places where people go to watch films.
